datacore: Official R Client for DataCore Vietnamese Financial Data

Source: R/datacore-package.R
datacore-package.Rd

Tibble-native R client for the DataCore catalog of Vietnamese financial, alternative, and economic data.

Getting started

Set the DATACORE_API_KEY environment variable (or pass api_key to datacore_client()) and construct a client:


dc <- datacore_client()
dc_search(dc, "VN30")
vn30 <- dc_get(dc, "equity.vn30.daily", start = "2024-01-01")
